finding: F01 Homepage rendering waits for business state
evidence: PrototypeProvider returns RouteLoadingPage until loadState resolves; preceding same-session browser samples measured state duration 8.1 and 11.4 seconds, while isolated origin was approximately 0.33s. Not field CWV.
fix: Render public hero/content independently; defer dynamic catalogue and account initialization; test delayed/failed state API.

finding: F02 Previous hashed assets unavailable after release
evidence: Previous main-DLJpquzR.js and AnswerWorkspace-XxiamCl0.js returned 404 in preceding production probes. User incidence unknown.
fix: Retain compatible immutable assets across releases and add old-tab navigation acceptance.

finding: F03 Public legal URLs return homepage shell
evidence: /terms and /privacy HTTP 200 share homepage H1/body/canonical and return X-Robots-Tag noindex, follow; sitemap excludes them.
fix: Serve standalone public legal HTML and self-canonical; keep login and private app routes noindex.

finding: F04 WWW host serves duplicate content without redirect
evidence: https://www.mianshiwen.cn/ returns 200 with canonical to non-www; http://mianshiwen.cn/ correctly redirects 308 to HTTPS.
fix: Plan tested permanent canonical-host redirects preserving path/query and existing authenticated/deep-link behavior.

finding: F05 Pricing page omits actual public prices
evidence: /pricing is independent HTML but says current prices require login; homepage static HTML also omits amounts although rendered homepage shows current paid passes.
fix: Generate public price HTML from a single validated catalogue snapshot with publication/update rules; never hardcode test prices.

finding: F06 Operator information remains unresolved in About copy
evidence: /about states registered operator awaits verification, /contact supplies support channels but no operator identity. User previously supplied operator name; domestic contracting entity still needs confirmation.
fix: Confirm domestic operating entity then align public about/contact/legal and Organization identity; keep contact@oneshowailab.com.

finding: F07 Existing guides lack task-specific screenshots
evidence: Audited Tencent Meeting audio setup and macOS permission pages contain a logo only; Tencent guide references official help generally without exact source links.
fix: Add versioned, redacted real setup screenshots, expected results, fallback steps and direct official references to existing guides.

finding: F08 Sitemap homepage modification date is stale
evidence: All sitemap lastmod entries are 2026-08-19 although homepage changed on 2026-09-07. Other pages may genuinely be unchanged.
fix: Update lastmod only for substantive changes from content source metadata; do not set all pages to today automatically.

finding: F09 Public sitemap routes have unique crawlable HTML
evidence: 30/30 sitemap URLs HTTP 200; 30 unique titles and body hashes; all have description, one H1, self-canonical; sampled nonexistent URL returns 404.
fix: Preserve these contracts with no-JS production smoke checks.

finding: F10 Robots and AI text files already exist
evidence: robots allows public crawling via wildcard and explicit named bots; llms.txt and llms-full.txt return 200. Availability does not prove citation/indexing.
fix: Maintain factual consistency; no need to recreate files or indiscriminately block unlisted bots.

finding: F11 Ranking and real-user CWV evidence unavailable
evidence: No authenticated Baidu index/query/crawl reports, analytics or citation benchmark supplied; PSI API rate limited. No ranking penalty or numeric SEO score can be established.
fix: Obtain read-only exports and measure branded/nonbranded landing-page cohorts before attributing ranking causes.
